name: Ocean Sweeper

attributes.attribute: one of the great treasures of the Irish Otherworld
brought the magic boat from the Otherworld
ocean god who came to own it

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: The Ocean Sweeper is an Irish mythological object. This artifact stood with the finest treasures of the Irish Otherworld. The boat moved through the sea by the power of its pilot's thoughts. The hero Lugh carried it out of the Otherworld. It became the property of Manannan mac Lir, the ocean god.

okr.objective: The Ocean Sweeper is a magical boat prized in the Irish Otherworld.
key_results: It moved across the sea by its pilot's thoughts.
